metadata.title: FIELDOS — Agricultural Intelligence Platform
metadata.description: FIELDOS is an agricultural intelligence platform designed to combine field imagery, agronomic knowledge, weather, soil, history, and outcomes into better field decisions.

common.conceptNote: A product concept for agricultural intelligence.

hero.headline: The operating intelligence layer for agriculture.
hero.body: FIELDOS brings imagery, field history, agronomic knowledge, weather, soil, interventions, and outcomes into one system—so every field can be understood in context.

fieldContext.title: A field is more than a picture.
fieldContext.p1: Most agricultural tools look at one signal at a time. A photograph. A weather forecast. A soil report. A satellite index. A farmer’s note.
fieldContext.p2: Agricultural decisions depend on how those signals relate to one another.
fieldContext.statement: FIELDOS is designed around the field—not the prompt.

intelligenceLoop.title: From observation to outcome.
intelligenceLoop.body: The system is designed as a continuous loop, not a single question and answer. Each step leaves a record the next season can use.

observe.label: Observe
observe.copy: Images, sensors, field notes, weather, soil, and remote sensing.

understand.label: Understand
understand.copy: Identify symptoms, anomalies, likely causes, and missing information.

decide.label: Decide
decide.copy: Compare options, risks, timing, agronomic evidence, and field context.

act.label: Act
act.copy: Turn recommendations into clear priorities and interventions.

measure.label: Measure
measure.copy: Track whether field conditions improve, decline, or remain unchanged.

learn.label: Learn
learn.copy: Every intervention and outcome becomes part of the field’s history.

productExperience.title: One field. One evolving source of truth.
productExperience.body: Each field carries a persistent model: what was observed, what was recommended, what was done, and what changed afterward.
productExperience.healthIndex: Composite canopy, moisture, and stress index
productExperience.mapAlt: Conceptual map of {name} showing health and anomaly zones.

architectureComparison.title: Built around continuous intelligence, not isolated answers.
architectureComparison.body: A chatbot can summarize. An intelligence layer has to remember the field—what happened, what was tried, and whether it worked.

knowledge.title: Agronomy should be grounded in evidence.
knowledge.body: FIELDOS is designed to consult a curated agricultural knowledge base—not to improvise from generic language alone. The sources below describe the intended architecture, not a claim that every corpus is already connected.
knowledge.quote: The goal is not simply to generate an answer. It is to find the information that actually applies to this field.

research.title: Peer-reviewed research
research.description: Primary literature used to ground hypotheses in published evidence.

extension.title: University extension
extension.description: Regional agronomic practice written for working farms.

regional.title: Regional guidance
regional.description: Climate, soil, and regulatory context that changes by geography.

expert.title: Expert knowledge
expert.description: Corrections, notes, and judgment from working agronomists.

protocols.title: Internal farm protocols
protocols.description: The operation’s own standards, thresholds, and treatment rules.

inputs.title: Every signal matters more in context.
inputs.body: Isolated measurements are noisy. Combined with crop stage, history, and local agronomy, they become evidence.

photos.label: Photos
photos.description: Visual symptoms, crop condition, weeds, pests, canopy.

field-data.label: Field data
field-data.description: Crop, cultivar, planting date, treatments, observations.

satellite.label: Satellite
satellite.description: Vegetation indices and temporal anomaly detection.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.description: Yield, recovery, disease progression, intervention response.

visionAnalysis.title: A photograph is evidence—not the conclusion.
visionAnalysis.body: Visual symptoms start a hypothesis. Confidence is explicit. The next step is confirmation in the field, not a finished diagnosis from a picture alone.
visionAnalysis.leafAlt: Stylized leaf showing chlorosis on older tissue.

drone.title: From individual plants to entire fields.
drone.body: Handheld photographs are the starting resolution. The platform is being designed so drone and satellite layers can expand that view without changing the underlying field model.
drone.disclaimer: Drone and remote-sensing capabilities represent the platform roadmap.
drone.rasterAlt: Stylized topographic raster of a field with an anomaly zone.

predictive.title: Understand what is happening. Then anticipate what happens next.
predictive.body: Predictive modules are shown here as conceptual outputs—the intended shape of the system, not validated production forecasts.

disease.title: Disease risk
disease.reason: Persistent leaf wetness + humidity profile + crop stage

moisture.title: Moisture stress
moisture.reason: Four-day rainfall deficit against current soil water balance

yield.title: Yield trajectory
yield.reason: Primary risk: heat stress during grain fill

anomalies.title: Field anomalies
anomalies.reason: Northwest canopy divergence against the five-year field baseline

outcomeLearning.title: Every decision creates new intelligence.
outcomeLearning.body: The most valuable agricultural dataset is not just image → diagnosis. It is the closed loop of context, action, and result.
outcomeLearning.quote: Over time, the platform can learn not only what a field looks like—but what actually worked.
outcomeLearning.memory: FIELDOS is being designed so every season becomes part of the system’s memory.

agronomistMode.title: AI that works with agronomists, not around them.
agronomistMode.body: Model output is a draft. Agronomists confirm, correct, and add context. Those corrections are intended to improve datasets, evaluation, retrieval, and future model performance.

points.retrieval: Retrieval can prefer locally corrected knowledge.
points.models: Future models train against lived field judgment.

agronomistMode.idle: Buttons demonstrate the review workflow. No data is stored.
agronomistMode.confirmed: Marked as confirmed. Expert agreement would be stored on the field record.
agronomistMode.corrected: Correction captured. The field model would retain both the original and the expert label.
agronomistMode.noted: Context would be attached to this observation for later retrieval.

geography.title: Agronomy is local.
geography.body: Same crop. Different region. Different soil. Different climate. Different recommendation. The system is designed so logic is filtered by place—not copied from one geography onto another.

ukraine.name: Ukraine
ukraine.note: Nitrogen timing follows a cooler spring and a later stem-elongation window.

kansas.name: Kansas
kansas.note: Moisture scarcity can mimic nutrient stress later in grain fill.

argentina.name: Argentina
argentina.note: Disease pressure rises earlier under prolonged leaf wetness.

france.name: France
france.note: Regulatory limits and cultivar choice constrain nitrogen strategy.

knowledgeGraph.title: From documents to connected agronomic knowledge.
knowledgeGraph.body: Search can find a page. A graph can hold the relationships agronomists actually use: symptoms, look-alikes, conditions, and crops.
knowledgeGraph.nitrogenCopy: Connected symptoms, soil conditions, and look-alike deficiencies that should be considered together.
knowledgeGraph.septoriaCopy: Pathogen context that depends on crop, weather, and growth stage—not a keyword match.
knowledgeGraph.alt: Network diagram connecting nitrogen deficiency and Septoria to related agronomic concepts.

dashboard.title: One view of what needs attention today.
dashboard.body: Priorities should surface before the agronomist has to hunt for them. This is a representative morning view, not a live operations feed.

userGroups.title: Built for decisions across the agricultural operation.

agronomists.title: Agronomists
agronomists.copy: Diagnose, verify, compare, and document field decisions.

companies.title: Agricultural companies
companies.copy: Standardize field intelligence across large operations.

researchers.title: Researchers & partners
researchers.copy: Connect agronomic science with real field outcomes.

roadmap.title: Build intelligence in layers.
roadmap.body: Capabilities are sequenced on purpose. Items listed under Next and Later are not presented as currently available.

vision.title: The farm should become more intelligent every season.
vision.body: FIELDOS is being designed to turn that accumulated knowledge into better decisions—field by field, season by season.

finalCta.title: Help build the intelligence layer for agriculture.
finalCta.body: We are looking for agronomists, growers, researchers, and agricultural partners who want to shape the platform from the beginning.
